salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the customer has a known number of sources and displays and wants reliable routing without building a full networked AV system.

talkTrack: It avoids manual cable changes by routing sources to the right display.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.
This 10x10 custom matrix chassis is built to your custom specification from a range of TX-H2X transmission cards, allowing hundreds of variations at your disposal.

The optional TX-H2X-OM3 transmission card now allows the powerful ability to pass the full bandwidth required of HDMI 2.0 over long distances via HDBaseT TM by utilizing Variable Compression technology over Multimode Fiber.

The integrated digital audio matrix can manage up to 30 multi-channel sources, which is made up of audio from the connected HDMI or remote HDBaseT TM sources, separate audio-only devices via S/PDIF and multi-channel ARC from HDBaseT TM zones.

The optional TX-H2X-HDBT input card allows source devices to be de-centralized and sent remotely back to the head-end. A large switching eco-system can be created using WyreStorm's huge range of HDBaseT TM transmission devices.
Fiber output supporting 4K/60 4:4:4 or 12-bit HDR to 300m/984ft
10-slot 4K UHD matrix switcher featuring 10 inputs and 10 switchable zone outputs with integrated audio matrixing
18Gb/s backplane for support of HDMI2.0 video standard
Supports HDR-10 HLG and Dolby Vision TM HDR content
Integrated audio matrix supports up to 30 audio inputs: HDMI de-embed, S/PDIF in and Audio Return
Audio DSP allows adjustment of volume, EQ and delay for every audio zone
Delivers PoH to every HDBaseT zone, powering receivers
SmartEDID TM feature dynamically solves mixed resolution conflicts when combining 2K/4K screens in the same installation
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
